# 9. Export

## Pre-upload Summary

Headline counts, average biomass and its composition by trophic group **across sites**, and the length extremes, gathered in one place.

```{r data_validation_summary}
#| message: true

survey_effort <- tibble(
  category = "Survey Effort",
  metric   = c("Sites", "Stations", "Observation records", "Fish", "Species"),
  value    = c(scales::comma(n_distinct(blt_stations$ps_site_id)),
               scales::comma(nrow(blt_stations)),
               scales::comma(nrow(blt_observations)),
               scales::comma(sum(blt_stations$total_count, na.rm = TRUE)),
               scales::comma(n_distinct(blt_biomass_by_station_taxa$accepted_name[blt_biomass_by_station_taxa$avg_count > 0])))
)

biomass_pct <- site_biomass_group |>
  group_by(trophic_group) |>
  summarize(avg_pct_biomass = round(mean(pct_biomass), 1), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(avg_pct_biomass)) |>
  # as.character() is load-bearing: indexing a named vector with a factor uses its
  # integer codes rather than its labels.
  mutate(trophic_group = trophic_labels[as.character(trophic_group)])

biomass_section <- tibble(
  category = "Biomass",
  metric   = c("Avg. Biomass (g/m²)", biomass_pct$trophic_group),
  value    = c(sprintf("%.1f", mean(site_taxa_biomass$avg_biomass_gm2, na.rm = TRUE)),
               sprintf("%.1f%%", biomass_pct$avg_pct_biomass))
)

length_extremes <- tibble(
  category = "Length Extremes",
  metric   = c("Largest", "Smallest"),
  value    = local({
    on <- dplyr::filter(blt_observations, !is.na(length_cm))
    c(paste0(on$accepted_name[which.max(on$length_cm)], " (", on$length_cm[which.max(on$length_cm)], " cm)"),
      paste0(on$accepted_name[which.min(on$length_cm)], " (", on$length_cm[which.min(on$length_cm)], " cm)"))
  })
)

bind_rows(survey_effort, biomass_section, length_extremes) |>
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = c("Survey Effort", "Biomass", "Length Extremes"))) |>
  light_gt(groupname_col = "category", rowname_col = "metric") |>
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Every record is on-transect: this expedition logged no off-transect observations.",
               locations = cells_row_groups(groups = "Survey Effort")) |>
  cols_label(value = "") |>
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = value) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = value)) |>
  tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
```

## Schema Validation & CSVs

Each table's column structure is validated against its BigQuery schema before writing — any drift fails loudly here rather than at upload time.

```{r prep_export}
#| message: true

blt_observations_out <- blt_observations |>
  mutate(transect_length_m = as.integer(transect_length_m),
         transect_width_m  = as.character(transect_width_m),
         count             = as.integer(count)) |>
  select(obs_id, ps_station_id, exp_id, diver, depth_m, station_label, transect,
         transect_length_m, transect_width_m, accepted_name, accepted_aphia_id, rank,
         family, trophic_group, count, length_cm, biomass_g, terminal_phase, notes)

blt_stations_out <- blt_stations |>
  mutate(depth_strata = as.character(depth_strata),
         n_transects  = as.integer(n_transects)) |>
  select(any_of(bigrquery::bq_table_fields(
    bigrquery::bq_table("pristine-seas", "uvs", "blt_stations")) |> purrr::map_chr("name")))
```

```{r export_csv}
#| message: true

observations_csv <- validate_and_export_csv(
  df        = blt_observations_out,
  table_ref = "uvs.blt_observations",
  label     = "Observations",
  path      = file.path(data_out, paste0(exp_id, "_uvs_blt_observations.csv")))

biomass_csv <- validate_and_export_csv(
  df        = blt_biomass_by_station_taxa,
  table_ref = "uvs.blt_biomass_by_station_taxa",
  label     = "Biomass by Station | Taxa",
  path      = file.path(data_out, paste0(exp_id, "_uvs_blt_biomass_by_station_taxa.csv")))

stations_csv <- validate_and_export_csv(
  df        = blt_stations_out,
  table_ref = "uvs.blt_stations",
  label     = "Stations",
  path      = file.path(data_out, paste0(exp_id, "_uvs_blt_stations.csv")))
```
